notes.title: Taste of Power donating 10% to COVID-19 relief fund!
notes.notes:
In order to kill boredom caused by the COVID-19 lockdown throughout the world we have decided to donate 10% of all sales in the entire month of April to CEPI, who has moved quickly and collaboratively to rapidly develop vaccines against the COVID-19 virus. CEPI also collaborates with GSK and will use their pandemic vaccine adjuvant platform technology to enhance the development of an effective vaccine.
For more information, please check out: https://cepi.net/covid-19/

notes.title: Update for Taste of Power
notes.notes:
Greetings!

We have released an update for Taste of Power.
It finalized the system of balances and changed the characteristics of a number of troops. Improved artificial intelligence and fixed a some of errors that arose earlier.

Best regards,
Taste of Power Team

notes.title: Taste of Power Launch Discount
notes.notes:
Greetings.

We planned to set a discount on the game on the day the Taste of Power was released. But due to technical problems, the discount was set only on 10/11/2019.
For those who have already bought the game before, we’d suggest requesting a refund if eligible and re-purchase at the new price.

If you've experienced any problems regarding the discount, please contact us via email: oneoceanua@gmail.com

Best regards,
OneOcean team.

notes.title: The Taste of Power game has been finally released.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31510811/f51b7227e55c60297ea396dd936b9c63c4681de3.png[/img]
Greetings!

Today, the Taste of Power game has been finally released.

We have come a long way and thank those who supported us during early access. Now the game has campaign, survival and confrontation modes with new maps, as well as multiplayer. 

If you've experienced any problems in Taste of Power or have suggestions, please contact us via email: oneoceanua@gmail.com
We would appreciate any feedback!

Enjoy the Taste of Power!

Best regards,
OneOcean team.

notes.title: Game campaign is available
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31510811/cc06297318e07043470ea3e78bd76ca4753b7656.jpg[/img]

Greetings!

Friends, we have already finished the work on the campaign and are now actively testing the game.
We will need a few extra weeks.
The release will take place on October 10, 2019.

In the meantime, you can already be the first to try out the campaign. The localization is temporarily disabled in the game . It will appear in the release version.

Best regards,
Taste of Power Team

notes.title: Game Release News
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31510811/1ba8b81b872e953d51a7628af18e156aec9fb7ed.png[/img]

Greetings! 

Very little time is left before the early access to the Taste of Power is over.

Taste of Power Team.

notes.title: Multiplayer and much more
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31510811/eb5d42eed948532ff00fbf25de67280228260d02.png[/img]

Greetings! 

We have released a new update for the Taste of Power.
The multiplayer was added to the game. It works in test mode and we still have to implement a lot and refine it. But you can already play with your friends online and improve your tactical skills.

In addition, many new things were added to the game:
- We added the ability to play mirror matches, such as Europe vs Europe or China vs China…
- We finalized the game interface, changed a lot of icons and much more.
- The game is translated into Russian.

Our small indie team consisting of 3 people continues developing the game. We are working on creating a gaming campaign and soon you will be able to try it out.

To search for opponents and discuss game mechanics, we invite you to the Discord group: https://discordapp.com/channels/460860571852734484/460860572343336972

notes.title: Update of the warfare mechanics
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31510811/86ab07a641872954d5fed27677c7d019d93c2b45.jpg[/img]

Hello friends!
Over the past month we have focused on improving the warfare mechanics.
We have improved the squad management. Now they almost never overlap each other. As a result, the battles have become even more ambitious, and the control of the positioning of your troops is even more important now.


We continue working on the multiplayer. We will try and add it in the nearest future.

Help us become better - write in the comments on what you think of the current changes and what has to be improved or added in the nearest future.

notes.title: Wargame Mode
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31510811/dd749472f7a0c9424ec46c84984825fa500f6323.jpg[/img]

Greetings! 

Today we have released a new update. You will see many new things:
We have added the Wargame Mode. It automates construction and the process of ordering troops. You will only have to choose development priorities and conduct warfare.

We have added a new map "Brave New World". It is available in Survival and Skirmish modes.
Achievements added to the game.
We made changes to the line of Chinese troops to improve the game balance.
Now each game side has engineers who can build underground passages. Now you will have even more chances of attacking the enemy’s defenseless positions.

Your opinion is very important! Please, leave your comments in the discussion of the game. Together we can significantly improve the game!

notes.title: A new game mode — “Survival”
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31510811/0e4166a04f1278308a8b1d2fa5dc3df6ac00ec31.png[/img]
Greetings!
Today we released an update where you will find a new game mode — “Survival”.
In this mode, you will need to counter threats and last for a certain period.
After this, the help will arrive, helping you to destroy the enemy settlements.
This mode is best for beginners to get to know the unique types of troops and game mechanics in general.  

In addition, we have made a number of improvements in UI and game mechanics.
Soon we will add 2 new game maps, new abilities of the troops and expand the game mechanics.

Please share your opinion about the game in the comments. With their help, we can improve the quality of the game.

notes.title: Taste of Power March Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31510811/28d452733bdb3163f7a2bb8d95cf94108a4daa0c.png[/img]

Greetings!

Today an update for early access to the Taste of Power has been released.

The third game side of the Timurids appeared in it. It is represented by the warriors of the Middle East. War elephants, chariots with incendiary oils, engineers who can build underground tunnels and a lot more will be under your control.

In April we will present an update where a new "Survival" mode will appear.

notes.title: Taste of Power is released in early access.
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31510811/f0a472ff17d4c1b3676717329ded54107324e17d.png[/img]

Nowadays Taste of Power is in the early access.
We have added a lot of new content:
The game has new buildings for the study of technologies and the defense of the cities.
There are new types of troops.
In addition to this, a lot of technology, capability to trade and rob caravans were added to the game.
Besides, we have improved the graphics of the game, added new maps and refined the training system.

We really appreciate your feedback on the improvements. Write them in the discussion on Steam!

notes.title: The new update of the free demo.
notes.notes:
We have updated the free demo of the game.
The main emphasis was placed on the level design. You have already seen the screenshots of the updated map and now you can play on it.
In addition, we finalized the mechanics of the battle, making it more dynamic. And changed the approach to the training system: now the hints appear during the game and make the acquaintance with the game more simple and understandable.

We really appreciate your feedback on the improvements. Write them in the discussion on Steam!

notes.title: Updated free demo of the Taste of Power
notes.notes:
We released an updated free demo of the Taste of Power.

It improved graphics and interface, expanded the game mechanics and reworked the training system.

Your opinion is very important to us. Write it in the discussion on Steam.

We wish you a nice weekend!
